description_en: Searches for images in a media set based on specified conditions, such as time, location, tags, and facial features. The results can be sorted based on specified requirements
description_zh: 调用FindImages接口根据指定条件，例如时间、地点、标签、人物特征等，搜索媒体集中图片。并可以按照给定要求进行排序
kebab_example: aliyun imm find-images --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --image-size-range MinWidth_:100,_MaxWidth_:3000,_MinHeight_:50,_MaxHeight_:5000 --image-time-range Start_:_2020-11-10T00:00:01.544Z_,_End_:_2020-11-25T00:00:01.544Z --create-time-range Start_:_2020-11-10T00:00:01.544Z_,_End_:_2020-11-25T00:00:01.544Z --modify-time-range Start_:_2020-11-10T00:00:01.544Z_,_End_:_2020-11-25T00:00:01.544Z --source-type image --source-uri-prefix oss://imm-test/ --remarks-a-prefix remark --remarks-b-prefix remark --tag-names '脸_,_人物' --ocr-contents-match myh --age-range Start_:0,_End_:99 --gender MALE --emotion HAPPY --order-by CreateTime --order ASC --marker imm --location-boundary TopLeft_:_50.2,100.1_,_BottomRight_:_30.5,120.1 --remarks-c-prefix remark --remarks-d-prefix remark --biz-external-id externalId001 --group-id group-not-grouped --limit 20 --faces-modify-time-range Start_:_2020-11-10T00:00:01.544Z_,_End_:_2020-11-25T00:00:01.544Z --tags-modify-time-range Start_:_2020-11-10T00:00:01.544Z_,_End_:_2020-11-25T00:00:01.544Z --address-line-contents-match zhejiang --remarks-array-a-in remarka1_,_remarka2 --remarks-array-b-in remarkb1_,_remarkb2 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FindImages

parameters.help_en: The project name
parameters.help_zh: 项目名称
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.help_zh: 媒体集的唯一标识
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en: The image size range in JSON format: `{"MinWidth":100,"MaxWidth":3000,"MinHeight":50,"MaxHeight":5000}`
parameters.help_zh: 图片大小范围，使用JSON格式表示，格式为`{"MinWidth":100,"MaxWidth":3000,"MinHeight":50,"MaxHeight":5000}`
parameters.name: image_size_range

parameters.help_en:

`{"Start":"1970-01-01T00:00:01.544Z","End":"2199-01-01T00:00:01.544Z"}`
parameters.help_zh:
图片的时间范围，该时间从EXIF信息获取，使用JSON格式表示，格式为
`{"Start":"1970-01-01T00:00:01.544Z","End":"2199-01-01T00:00:01.544Z"}`

parameters.name: create_time_range

parameters.help_en:
The time range during which the image was updated. The value is in JSON format:
`{"Start":"1970-01-01T00:00:01.544Z","End":"2199-01-01T00:00:01.544Z"}`

image: image

image：图片

parameters.help_zh: 性别，可选值为MALE和FEMALE

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values: ASC and DESC.

ASC: ascending order
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，可选值为ASC和DESC。

ASC：升序
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The marker from which to return image information in lexicographic order. If this parameter is not specified, images are returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 从Marker开始按字典序返回图片信息列表。如果不设置此参数，则从头开始返回图片
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The geographic location range in JSON format: `{"TopLeft":"50.2,100.1","BottomRight":"30.5,120.1"}`.

The format of TopLeft (upper-left) and BottomRight (lower-right) vertices is `lat,long`, which consists of floating-point numbers separated by a comma (,).

The Top value must be greater than the Bottom value, and the Left value must be less than the Right value
parameters.help_zh:
地理位置范围，使用JSON格式表示，格式为`{"TopLeft":"50.2,100.1","BottomRight":"30.5,120.1"}`。

其中TopLeft（左上）和BottomRight（右下）两个顶点的格式为`lat,long`，是以英文逗号（,）分隔的浮点数。

Top的值必须大于Bottom的值，Left的值必须小于Right的值
parameters.name: location_boundary

parameters.help_zh: 标记信息的前缀，用于前缀匹配
parameters.name: remarks_c_prefix

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the remarks information, used for prefix matching
parameters.help_zh: 标记信息的前缀，用于前缀匹配

parameters.name: external_id

parameters.help_zh: 人脸分组ID。如果人脸未分组，则此参数返回值为group-not-grouped
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_zh: 返回图片的最大个数，默认值为20，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: limit
